neighbours.label: the slot where 'empty (stomach)' or 'fasting' is due: medicine, food or test timing relative to eating ('take … on an' → empty stomach, 'with or without food'); health instructions unrelated to eating stay quiet
fire: For best absorption, swallow the iron tablet on an empty stomach.
Drinking coffee first thing in the morning on an empty stomach can cause heartburn.
The nurse reminded him that the thyroid pill should be taken on an empty stomach.
Patients are asked to arrive for the blood test in a fasting state.
Never drink strong alcohol on an empty stomach.
This medicine may be taken with or without food.
He gets nauseous if he swallows the vitamins on an empty stomach.
Do not eat for eight hours before the glucose test, so that it is done on an empty stomach.
quiet: For best results, apply the cream to clean, dry skin.
Drinking coffee late in the evening can keep you awake.
The nurse reminded him that the eye drops should be kept in the fridge.
Patients are asked to arrive for the X-ray in comfortable clothing.
Never leave the medicine bottle open on the shelf.
This medicine may cause drowsiness or blurred vision.
He gets dizzy if he stands up too quickly.
Do not drive for eight hours after the eye examination.
